name: Metacare Co., Ltd.
summary: Metacare Co., Ltd. engages in the medical, life and health, pharmaceutical, and storage businesses. It sells medical equipment and appliances, health equipment, medicines, and computer servers. Metacare Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Wooridul Life Sciences Limited and changed its name to Metacare Co., Ltd. in April 2014. Metacare Co., Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
